text.text: Customer service is so good with this company. Called on a very cold (and I’m sure busy day) and they were able to make arrangements to have someone out sooner due to hearing my baby in the background. Just so caring which seems so rare these days. The tech was super knowledgeable and had a ton of experience which we appreciated.

text.text: Highly recommend them if you like old school honest work at great prices.   They don’t play games like most other HVAC contractor's and they will recommend the most appropriate system that meets your needs.  They came highly recommended by friends that had used their services twice before for two complete systems.  Our experience was on track.   It’s hard to find contractors like this anymore.  Get their free quote and compare them yourself; you won’t be disappointed.

text.text: We had no AC and used fuel oil to heat our home. Wolfe & Sons installed a completely new HVAC system in our home that other companies thought it couldn't be done. They were clean, professional and the customer service was great. With such a big project, they were able to get it all done quickly and efficiently.

text.text: I can’t say enough good things about Wolfe & Sons. As a property manager, time is of the essence to get issues resolved for tenants and that have always been very quick to any service call. They don’t up sell and find ways to diagnose and repair any problems before making a recommendation to replace. They have replaced 2 full systems at a great value and have warranties that back up their work. They are a great company and value. I’d recommend them for all of your HVAC needs!

text.text:
John & the rest of the team at Wolfe & Sons are great.

Responsive, reasonably priced, & do phenomenal work. They are honest with you, & work with you to give you exactly what you need, not try to sell you a bunch of things you don't need.

I've had them do a few things over the past couple years & I'm not sure I'll use anybody else in the city for my HVAC.

As long as they are in business, they will get my business.
